description: This file defines the TranslationLanguageRenderer class, which handles rendering entity translations in their row language within Drupal views. It manages language-specific query modifications, retrieves language codes, and builds view representations for entities based on language context.

classes.name: TranslationLanguageRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders entity translations in their row language within Drupal views, managing language-specific query adjustments and rendering logic.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Modifies the query to include language code information if the site is multilingual and the entity is translatable.

methods.name: getLangcodeTable
methods.description: Determines the appropriate database table that contains the 'langcode' field, considering entity revisions.

methods.name: preRenderByRelationship
methods.description: Prepares the render output for entities in a specific relationship, building view representations per entity and language.

methods.name: renderByRelationship
methods.description: Returns the rendered view of an entity in a specific relationship, based on its language.

methods.name: getLangcode
methods.description: Retrieves the language code for a given row, defaulting to the site's default language if not set.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Provides cache contexts related to content languages for proper cache invalidation.
